title: Capture the 20 Zoning Resolution sections the worked readings of options 5, 8 (two buildings on one lot; a divided lot) and 9-10 rest on that are not yet captured (23-51, 22-12, 22-121, 22-122, 32-121, 54-311, 25-24, 25-241, 12-10-transit-zone-inner, 23-12, 23-371, 23-372, 23-35, 23-351, 23-352, 23-353, 32-421, 33-26, 33-301, 12-10-select-commercial-overlay), and correct the law library's stale capture states for options 2-3 and 6-7. Documents only: source-text snapshots in the existing zr_section_snapshot/v1 shape with byte-identical bundled copies; no rule, no reading of the text for any lot, no computed figure, no choice of what option 8 or option 10 means.
objective: Capture, from the official NYC DCP Zoning Resolution portal, the 20 sections that two independent sealed readings of options 5, 8 and 9-10 for the benchmark lot rest on and that are NOT in docs/research/zr-snapshots/v1/ (comparer return session-2026-10-15a/return-compare-options.md part 3): 23-51 (option 9-10: rooming units outside the density rules; under article-ii/chapter-3); 22-12 (option 9: Use Group II; under article-ii/chapter-2); 22-121 (option 9; under article-ii/chapter-2); 22-122 (option 9: districts barring rooming units; under article-ii/chapter-2); 32-121 (option 9: Use Group II in C districts; under article-iii/chapter-2); 54-311 (option 9: rooming-unit conversion; under article-v/chapter-4); 25-24 (option 10: parking general rule; under article-ii/chapter-5); 25-241 (option 10; under article-ii/chapter-5); 12-10-transit-zone-inner (option 10: the defined term; under article-i/chapter-2); 23-12 (option 8 meaning B: minimum lot area and width; under article-ii/chapter-3); 23-371 (option 8 meaning A: distance between buildings; under article-ii/chapter-3); 23-372 (option 8 meaning A: windows to lot lines; under article-ii/chapter-3); 23-35 (option 8 meaning A: courts; under article-ii/chapter-3); 23-351 (option 8 meaning A; under article-ii/chapter-3); 23-352 (option 8 meaning A: inner court; under article-ii/chapter-3); 23-353 (option 8 meaning A: outer court; under article-ii/chapter-3); 32-421 (option 5: storeys for shops; under article-iii/chapter-2); 33-26 (option 5: commercial rear yard; under article-iii/chapter-3); 33-301 (option 5: corner rear-yard waiver; under article-iii/chapter-3); 12-10-select-commercial-overlay (option 5: the defined term; under article-i/chapter-2). Each capture is one JSON in the existing zr_section_snapshot/v1 shape (templates: docs/research/zr-snapshots/v1/zr-24-33.snapshot.json and zr-23-344.snapshot.json; a 12-10 term: zr-12-10-transit-zone-outer.snapshot.json): official HTML node request plus the print/PDF entityprint cross-check, both channels sha256-pinned (or the documented 504/403 fallback, disclosed), the page's own Last Amended stamp, verbatim_excerpt with #term# markers and list letters taken from the official PRINT (the HTML <ol> can restart a list - M3-T008 G1 F1), any table carried cell-by-cell in the structured tables field with a placeholder token in the excerpt (the M3-T009 pattern), content_digest_sha256 = sha256(verbatim_excerpt), extraction_status extracted_draft, raw_html_verified false, the ADR-007 not-professionally-reviewed label. Each lands in docs/research/zr-snapshots/v1/ AND as a byte-identical copy in services/api/app/_zr_snapshots/v1/ produced by RUNNING services/api/scripts/sync_zr_snapshots.py (never edited). Every section number, title, URL and Last Amended date is taken from the page read for this pass. A listed node that does not exist (e.g. 'select commercial overlay' may not be a 12-10 defined term) or was renumbered is reported in the producer report, never invented. THEN correct the law library's capture states exactly as the comparer listed (part 4): option-02-03-affordable-and-senior-housing.md (the senior sub-terms, 27-111/131/133/14/151 and Appendix F are captured; 23-154 stays not captured; the singular term 'affordable independent residence for seniors'), option-06-07-community-facility.md (every zr-24-* section is captured; 24-161 supplies the R6B combination ceiling), options-sections.md line ~155 (66-11 defines 'mass transit station', not the transit zone) and the new captures' states; capture-state corrections only, no new reading. Documents only: no rule, no reading for a lot, no computed number, no eligibility determination; option 8's meaning (N1) and option 10's distinct meaning (N2) stay open owner questions. ALSO correct the library index docs/zoning-law-library/benchmark-r6b-sections.json: the 32-131 entry (Use Group III, community facilities) is marked 'followed: option 5/11 (C2-2 retail use permission)'; the retail permission for option 5 is 32-161 (Use Group VI); re-point 32-131 to the community-facility options (6, 7) and add capture-status entries for the 20 new sections where the index lists them.
business_reason: Two independent sealed readings per option (session 2026-10-15a) agree on the headline values of options 2-10 for the benchmark lot, but the values of options 5, 8 and 9-10 rest on sections that are read only live (23-51, 23-12, 23-371, 32-421, 33-26, 33-301 verified live by the comparer) or not at all; a rule or a reference case may cite a section only once it is captured with provenance (CLAUDE.md principles 2, 3, 12). The library notes for options 2-3 and 6-7 still say sections are not captured that M3-T008/M3-T009 captured, which misled two readers. This batch replaces the earlier option-8 Article VII Chapter 7 plan: the comparer found the district-boundary meaning is not this lot's situation (77-xx deferred). Remaining owed captures (community-facility use permission 22-131..22-135, 74-902/74-903, 23-63, 35-23, 35-24, 12-10 residential building / side lot line, 23-154 pre-2024) follow in a later task, one capture run at a time.

RISK 2: 12/5/2024 City of Yes renumbering - Article VII Chapter 7 and the 23-35x court group may have moved, merged or been retitled. Take every number, title and Last Amended date from the page read this pass; report, never invent, a missing or renumbered node (S4). The library's parenthetical titles are a summary, not a confirmed per-node title.

RISK 3: Big-page 504 / per-node 403 (DB-167) - Chapter-7 bodies were read live during M3-T007 and are large. Use the disclosed direct-GET browser-UA fallback, sha256-pinned; pause between requests; stop on repeated refusals (S9).
